text: ion. The cresols have been widely used in disinfectants for domestic and hospital use. Profile Decamethoxine is a quaternary ammonium antiseptic and disin- fectant with actions and uses similar to those of other cationic surfactants (see Cetrimide, p.1634). It is used topically for disin- fection of the skin and mucous membranes and for disinfection of equipment. Decamethoxine is also used as a gargle for infec- tions of the oral cavity and has been used topically or as an irri- gation for infections of the skin and various body cavities.
